source_text.body:
Let Claude queue songs and build playlists in Spotify
The author installed a Spotify MCP server so Claude can queue songs, find music and create playlists in their account.
·
Nov 11, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
The author installed a Spotify MCP server and connected it to Claude. This let Claude act inside their Spotify account. The post, which is a short video, says Claude can queue songs, find music, and create a new playlist. It doesn't describe the setup steps or any prompts.
How it went
The post says Claude can now queue songs, find music, and create a playlist. It gives no numbers, example results, or limitations.
Worth knowing
The post is only a brief video blurb. A separate post from the same author, 'Installing the Spotify MCP Server', appears to cover the install steps.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Using my connected Spotify account, build a playlist called [playlist name] with about [number] songs that fit [mood or genre, artists I like]. Skip anything I've listed as disliked: [artists or songs]. Show me the track list for approval before creating the playlist, then tell me when it's done and queue the first three songs.
Original source: https://mcpjam.substack.com/p/i-gave-claude-access-to-my-spotify
